typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		{Summary|Runtime|Power State} as string,
		{Summary|Runtime|Power State Timestamp} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PowerState
PowerState derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp(),
		Power_State_Timestamp_clean = trim({Summary|Runtime|Power State Timestamp})) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Summary_Runtime_Power_State as string,
		Summary_Runtime_Power_State_Timestamp as string,
		report_name as string,
		Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Summary_Runtime_Power_State = {Summary|Runtime|Power State},
		Summary_Runtime_Power_State_Timestamp = {Summary|Runtime|Power State Timestamp},
		report_name,
		Name),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
